name: root-crate-load-ingest-split
body: The `load` module is organized as `src/load/parquet.rs`, `src/load/tables.rs`, and `src/load/export.rs` under `src/load/mod.rs`; the `ingest` module is organized as `src/ingest/identity.rs`, `src/ingest/blacklist.rs`, `src/ingest/render.rs`, and `src/ingest/edges.rs` under `src/ingest/mod.rs`. The `rust.apg.ingest` crate root declares `ingest_records`, `claim`, `ingest`, `opt`, `spec_node`, `insert_node`, `finalize_graph`, `IngestOptions`, `Reuse`, and `IngestReport`. The module FQNs `rust.apg.ingest` and `rust.apg.load` anchor their submodules.
